question: What temperature did sensor 31.0 measure on 2004-02-28 at 01:00:46?

graph.cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 31.0})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-02-28T01:00:46"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.temperature AS temperature
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
